status: v4 (independent QA of v3: one tint pass, dev/shots/textures/branson/v4/): cream / white / lap tints raised and warmed for the shaded walls, calmer cedar tile, concrete on the Commons hall's own side walls, cream stucco behind the gym's colonnades, New House pale yellow. v3: switched on (src/campuses/branson/campus.js files.textures). `?tex=0` is the look before the pack. Every building was re-checked against the current geometry, the Google 3D tiles obliques and the photos after the campus's 8 QA rounds; side-by-sides in dev/shots/textures/branson/v3/.
method: Architect project photos (Turnbull Griffin Haesloop: Student Commons, Fine Arts Center, via e-architect) and the school's own site (quad, gym from the field, a drone still over Katharine Branson Hall), plus Google 3D tiles obliques for the buildings no photo shows (the hall's walls, Tallant, New House, the Music Hall). The Street View cache shows only hedges. Swatches are median LINEAR RGB (refs.py swatch) scaled against white trim (0.80). The 3D tiles are washed out (cream reads white, terracotta reads salmon): they decide WHAT a surface is, the photos decide its colour. Wall and roof tints (src/campuses/branson/extras.js PACK) were then set in the game: straight-on probes of one sunlit and one shaded wall per material, median of the modal-luminance pixels (v3 numbers under `calibration`).

wiring: src/campuses/branson/school.js lookOf(ctx): one place that answers every bucket and tint of the build, pack on or off (`?tex=0` renders the old look from the same build)

roofs: hipRoof / polyRoof / ridgeRoof / mansard / gableRoof take opts.bucket; ridgeRoof and mansard then map uv from the face's own plane (extras.js eaveUV) so tile courses lie level on every hip face
gym: facade-kit skin { brick: 'brCedar' }, STYLES.brGym.tint = PACK.cedar (kit.js addStyles(ctx)); gable ends get wall-plane uv
Commons: wings stuccoWalls bucket 'brFormConcrete'; hall gableRoof bucket 'brSeam' + soffit
Fine Arts Center, link, Music Hall: stuccoWalls bucket 'brLap'
